pr_body:
This patch reduces the runtime of this test from 50s to 15s. To cut the
remaining fat:
- Each WaitForReplicatedTime call takes about 5s. Other tests take this long
  too.
- We wait 5 seconds for the AOST the reader tenant uses to observe the
  replicated data.

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/131611
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/131674)
created a tracking issue for further reducing the runtime of these e2e tests: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/132159
